name: Wei Liang Tan
bio:
Wei Liang's fascination with motorsport began at a young age, captivated by the precision and engineering of Formula 1 cars. He pursued a diploma in Mechanical Engineering from Ngee Ann Polytechnic, excelling in courses related to materials science and manufacturing processes. Driven by a desire to contribute directly to race teams, Wei Liang is eager to hone his skills in a fast-paced environment, focusing on improving the reliability and performance of vehicle components.

Wei Liang believes that a meticulous and systematic approach is essential for a machinist. He is deeply committed to accuracy and detail, knowing that even the smallest errors can have significant consequences on the track. He's not afraid to ask questions and learn from experienced team members, seeing collaboration as a vital part of continuous improvement.

What sets Wei Liang apart is his innovative mindset. He's constantly seeking ways to optimize existing designs and processes, exploring new materials and techniques to enhance performance. While lacking practical experience, he is a quick learner and determined to become a valuable asset to any racing team.
